title: Southline front end: title, menus, settings, wardrobe, loading, arrival intros

items.name: Rename to SOUTHLINE: brand.js, logo, title, loading, index.html title, desktop productName/window/menu, HUD strings (saves keep their old folder)
New logo: slanted heavy wordmark, cream fill, plum outline, offset extrude, pink brush swoosh and glow, striped sunset disc behind skyline and palms (original SVG, bundled font via --ps-cond)
Loading screen to the mockup: stylized key art, logo top-left, LOADING bar bottom-left, rotating tip bottom-right; boot and into-game; bar tied to streaming (readyAround 220 m)

Stylized key art baked from an in-engine bay render (posterize, ink edges, painted sky, sun, skyline, causeway, palms, halftone, grain): public/assets/ui/keyart_loading.webp; graded live stills keyart_ocean/keyart_keys.webp
Title background: key art with Ken Burns move and light rays by default; live cinematic scenes with DOF, 20% flare, lower exposure and bloom behind ?titlebg=live
Menu: Continue (save exists), New Game, Online join form, Wardrobe, Settings, Credits, Quit (desktop only); focus animations, UI sounds on the UI bus, keyboard and controller nav
Title music: the game's own theme (theme/port_solana_theme.aac) on its own bus, looped, world ducked
items.evidence: game.audio.debug.music shows id menu, station url:theme, gain 0.85 (headless is muted)

items.name: New Game into gameplay: loading screen, crane-down handoff, HUD live, wanted cleared

Settings: presets (look track), render scale, FPS cap 60/120/unlimited, shadows, draw distance, motion blur, DOF, grain, FPS counter, audio mix, key rebinding, mouse sensitivity, invert Y, fullscreen, HUD scale, subtitles; live apply over the scene
Wardrobe: lit turntable stage through the post chain, drag / zoom, Tops / Bottoms / Shoes / Accessories on the real outfit system, save slice; also in the pause menu
Laptop screens 1280x800, 1440x900, 1512x982: menu, loading, settings, wardrobe fit
UI palette: sunset pink, purple, yellow, cream accents; HUD aqua-green replaced (notifications, minimap arrow, health bar pink, cash badge gold)
Fonts bundled locally (OFL), no CDN; injectFonts bug in hud.js fixed; credits updated
Arrival intros: data-driven places (club, hotel, marina, Keys bar, downtown), 6 shots cut on bar lines (beats.json), title card, once per save, skippable
